usage: Use 深藍色 to name a dark blue colour, like a shirt, bag, or wall.
You can put it after a noun: 深藍色衫 means a dark blue shirt.
It is common in everyday speech when talking about clothes, paint, cars, or home items.
If you want to compare shades, 深藍色 is darker than 藍色 and lighter than 黑色.
